semantic_filter: uuid is never null and is unique, so one row is exactly one printing
aggregation_semantics: distinct count of uuid equals the number of printings; a plain row count is also a printing count
validation: verified: 56822 rows and 56822 distinct uuid values

semantic_filter: never null; identifies the card independently of the set it was printed in
aggregation_semantics: distinct count of scryfallOracleId equals the number of distinct cards
grain: one value shared by all printings of the same card
validation: verified: 21769 distinct values over 56822 printing rows

semantic_filter: not a unique card key: 7 card names carry more than one scryfallOracleId
aggregation_semantics: distinct count of name approximates but does not exactly equal the number of distinct cards
grain: one value shared by all printings of the same card
validation: verified: 21738 distinct names versus 21769 distinct oracle ids

semantic_filter: unique and never null; a few sets exist without any card printing
aggregation_semantics: distinct count of code equals the number of sets
validation: verified: 551 distinct code values

semantic_filter: every value exists in sets.code; the reverse does not hold because 15 sets contain no printings
aggregation_semantics: join key from printings to their set
validation: verified: 536 distinct cards.setCode values, all present in sets.code

semantic_filter: a reported size attribute, not a count of rows; baseSetSize counts the set's own numbered cards while totalSetSize also includes related cards
aggregation_semantics: use as a reported size, not as an aggregation over printings
validation: verified: baseSetSize and totalSetSize are nullable integers

semantic_filter: null for single-face printings; a, b, c, d, e for faces of multi-face printings
aggregation_semantics: faces must be combined through the printing uuid before counting cards
validation: verified: side is null for 55455 rows and non-null for 1367 rows

semantic_filter: the same text is repeated for different printings of the same card
aggregation_semantics: count distinct ruling text to count distinct clarifications
grain: one row per ruling attached to a printing
validation: verified: 87769 rows over 19593 distinct texts

semantic_filter: references cards.uuid at printing level, not at card identity level
aggregation_semantics: distinct count of uuid gives the number of printings that carry at least one ruling
validation: verified: 26141 distinct uuid values

semantic_filter: never null; four print rarities are stored
aggregation_semantics: distribution of printings across rarity values
validation: verified: common, uncommon, rare, mythic only

semantic_filter: null means the card is colorless; there is no explicit colorless token
aggregation_semantics: distribution of printings across color combinations
grain: one comma-separated color list per printing
validation: verified: 12540 null values, 5305 values containing a comma

semantic_filter: null means the card has no color identity; values may include colors absent from the mana cost
aggregation_semantics: distribution of printings across color identities
grain: one comma-separated color list per printing
validation: verified: 6224 null values, 8044 values containing a comma, 31 distinct values

semantic_filter: comma-separated with no space; old printings use Summon where modern printings use Creature
aggregation_semantics: distribution of printings across card types
grain: one comma-separated type list per printing
validation: verified: 0 rows contain a comma followed by a space

semantic_filter: comma-separated with no space; null when the card has no subtype
aggregation_semantics: distribution of printings across creature and other subtypes
grain: one comma-separated subtype list per printing
validation: verified: e.g. Human,Wizard with no space after the comma

semantic_filter: comma-separated; null for the majority of printings
aggregation_semantics: distribution of printings across supertypes such as Legendary or Basic
grain: one comma-separated supertype list per printing
validation: verified: 48982 null values; values combine as Legendary,Snow

semantic_filter: human-readable line that separates types from subtypes with an em dash; not the safest column for type filtering
aggregation_semantics: descriptive display only
validation: verified: 34594 rows contain an em dash and no row uses a plain hyphen as separator

semantic_filter: lowercase format names; the set of formats a printing has rows for varies
aggregation_semantics: distribution of legality rows across formats
validation: verified: 15 distinct lowercase format values

semantic_filter: capitalized values Legal, Banned, Restricted; no Not Legal value exists
aggregation_semantics: count of legality rows per status; absence of a row means the printing is not legal in that format
validation: verified: exactly three distinct status values

semantic_filter: null for printings without a mana cost, predominantly lands
aggregation_semantics: distribution of printings across cost patterns
validation: verified: 7323 null values

semantic_filter: uses the same language vocabulary as set_translations.language
aggregation_semantics: count of localized card rows per language
grain: one value per localized card row
validation: verified: 15 distinct values

semantic_filter: uses the same language vocabulary as foreign_data.language
aggregation_semantics: count of translated set names per language
grain: one value per set translation row
validation: verified: 10 distinct values, each covering 121 sets

semantic_filter: null for some sets; enumerates product categories
aggregation_semantics: distribution of sets across product categories
validation: verified: 20 distinct values including expansion, core, promo, masters, memorabilia, token, funny

semantic_filter: ISO date text; the snapshot ends in March 2021
aggregation_semantics: ordering and time-window filtering of sets
validation: verified: range 1993-08-05 to 2021-03-19, never null

semantic_filter: never null, but includes extreme joke-card values
aggregation_semantics: average or sum over printings; restrict to a plausible range for meaningful averages
validation: verified: range 0.0 to 1000000.0 with one joke card at the maximum

semantic_filter: populated only for multi-face layouts (transform, split, adventure, aftermath)
aggregation_semantics: per-face cost; summing it over rows double counts multi-face printings
validation: verified: 955 non-null values confined to four multi-face layouts

semantic_filter: text column; null for most non-creature printings, and non-null for Vehicles which are not typed Creature
aggregation_semantics: numeric comparison only after excluding symbolic values
validation: verified: distinct values include 0, 0.5, -1, 1+*, 2+*, *, *², ?, ∞, 99

semantic_filter: text column with the same symbolic values as power
aggregation_semantics: numeric comparison only after excluding symbolic values
validation: verified: distinct values include 1+*, 7-*, *, *+1, ∞

semantic_filter: integer 0/1 flag marking printings that are not the card's first appearance
aggregation_semantics: count or share of printings that are reprints
validation: verified: integer column with default 0

semantic_filter: comma-separated set codes for the whole card identity, repeated identically on every printing of that card
aggregation_semantics: count of set codes in the list gives the reprint breadth per card identity
validation: verified: e.g. 10E,8ED,9ED,DDC,DVD,IMA,INV,JMP,MB1,P02,PS11,PSAL,S99

semantic_filter: the localized name of one printing in one language
aggregation_semantics: count of localized names per language
grain: one value per printing per language
validation: verified: e.g. Ausgewaehlter der Ahnfrau for the German row of a printing

semantic_filter: localized rules text; flavorText and type carry the same localization
aggregation_semantics: localized text content
grain: one value per printing per language
validation: verified: the German row carries both type and rules text

semantic_filter: translated set name keyed by set code and language
aggregation_semantics: one translated name per set per language
grain: one value per set per language
validation: verified: 1210 rows covering 121 sets in 10 languages
